verdict.rationale: Cognee is explicitly open-source and self-hostable (run the full engine locally 'free, forever'), which reduces vendor lock-in, and cognee-cli offers a 'report' command that describes a dataset's graph contents. However, there is no documented explicit export command or machine-readable dump (e.g., JSON/CSV/graph export) for pulling full memory data out of Cognee — the only CLI data-movement command shown (`push`) moves data INTO Cognee Cloud, not out in a portable format. Missing for 10: a documented export/dump API or CLI command producing a portable machine-readable file, documentation of the underlying storage schema for direct access, and any independent confirmation that data can be fully extracted without proprietary tooling.
